title: My First Job Interview
text:
I will never forget my first job interview. I had applied for a position as a junior accountant at a large company in Istanbul, and I was extremely nervous. The night before, I couldn't sleep, so I got up at five and read my notes again.

Unfortunately, the metro broke down on the way, and I arrived ten minutes late. I should have left home earlier. The manager, Ms Arslan, was very kind, though. She asked me about my studies and why I wanted to work for them. Then she asked a difficult question: "Tell me about a problem you couldn't figure out alone." I panicked and gave a very short answer.

A week later, they called me and said they had chosen another candidate. I was disappointed, but Ms Arslan gave me some useful feedback. She told me to prepare examples from my own experience. If I had prepared better, I would have answered that question more confidently. Three months later I had another interview, and this time I got the job.
